extracted.name: Cantaloupe Bread with Praline Glaze
extracted.description: This cantaloupe bread with praline glaze recipe features a moist bread made of cantaloupe, cinnamon, and ginger, topped with a brown sugar pecan glaze.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups cantaloupe - peeled, seeded and pureed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Lightly grease and flour two 9x5-inch loaf pans.

Beat sugar, puréed cantaloupe, oil, eggs, and vanilla in a large bowl with an electric mixer until well combined. Whisk flour, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, baking powder, and ginger together in a separate bowl. Stir flour mixture into cantaloupe mixture until combined. Divide batter evenly between the prepared pans.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the centers of loaves comes out clean, about 1 hour.
Meanwhile, make praline glaze: Combine brown sugar, pecans, and butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Cook on High in the microwave for about 3 minutes, stirring every minute, until smooth.
Pour sauce over warm loaves. Cool for 1 hour before serving.
